title: Aurora in the 1986 budget
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Aurora in the 1986 budget, about 1986; early 1990s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's a 1968, or sorry, 1986 budget, uh where it shows up as a line item for I think it like $2 billion or something

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels talks about Aurora, said to be a secret American aircraft programme. He says it shows up as a line item in the 1986 US budget, for something like 2 billion dollars, and that British Ministry of Defence papers touch on it too. In the same conversation he mentions Ben Rich, a former head of Lockheed's secret aircraft division, and if the budget line is real it would mean a hidden advanced aircraft was being paid for.
